preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 200000 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There are exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct vertices within the valid range.
The given edges form a valid tree structure (connected and acyclic).

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line.strip()) == 0 or (len(line.split()) == 2 and int(line.split()[0]) <= 200000 and int(line.split()[1]) > 0) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each non-empty line in stdout contains exactly two integers: a value i and a count, where i is at most 200,000 and count is positive.

postconditions.expression: sorted([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]) == [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
postconditions.description: The output lines are sorted in ascending order by the value i.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(1 for x in range(1, n+1) for y in range(x, n+1) if gcd_path(x, y, a, edges) == i) for i, count in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: For every output pair (i, count), count equals the number of pairs (x, y) with 1 <= x <= y <= n such that the GCD of values on the simple path between x and y is exactly i.

postconditions.expression: all(i not in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()] for i in range(1, 200001) if sum(1 for x in range(1, n+1) for y in range(x, n+1) if gcd_path(x, y, a, edges) == i) == 0)
postconditions.description: No value i is output if there are no pairs (x, y) such that g(x, y) equals i.
